privacy.title: Privacy Policy — Hecate
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Hecate is a personal map of the places you explore. This policy explains what information Hecate collects, why it is used, and the choices available to you.
privacy.account: Account information. When you create or sign in to an account, we process your email address and the authentication information needed to maintain your account.
privacy.location: Location and discovery data. When you deliberately start a journey, Hecate collects your precise location, time, and location accuracy to create your route and calculate the places you have discovered. Selecting Finish or Stop ends journey recording. While the app is open, Hecate also uses your location to show your position. During a recording, Hecate may remind you to stop after 15 minutes near one spot in an area you already discovered; the reminder does not stop recording.
privacy.reminders: Optional discovery reminders. If you enable discovery reminders in Account & sync, Hecate can check movement while your phone is in the background and suggest starting a journey after five minutes of movement through areas not yet on your discovery map. Movement through already discovered areas does not trigger a reminder. Reminder samples are processed on your device, not saved as a route, and not sent to your account. Only the reminder setting and the time of the last reminder are stored on your device. Turning reminders off stops this background monitoring when no journey is active.
privacy.technical: Technical information. Our service providers may process limited technical information, such as IP address and request logs, when the app connects to authentication, storage, or map-tile services. Hecate may send your current position to OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service to identify the city region containing it.
privacy.feedback: Optional feedback. If you send feedback, we store your account ID, the reason you select, any comments you provide, and an optional email address for a reply in our Supabase-backed database. A copy is also sent to our support Gmail inbox to notify the team. Only the Hecate team can read these submissions. Your account email is prefilled for a reply; you can change or remove it. The form does not include location or journey data.
privacy.use: We use your information to provide the app: authenticate you, save and synchronize your discoveries across your signed-in devices, show maps, and respond to support requests. We do not sell your location history or use it for advertising or cross-app tracking.
privacy.storage: Account, route, and discovery data are stored in our Supabase-backed database for your signed-in account. Hecate uses OpenFreeMap map tiles to display the map. These providers process data only as needed to provide their services.
privacy.choices: You can stop an active journey at any time and turn discovery reminders off in Account & sync. You can also control location and notification permissions in your device settings.
privacy.deletion: To delete your account and the discoveries and routes associated with it, open Hecate’s account and sync panel, select Delete account, and confirm. Deletion is permanent and cannot be undone. If you cannot access the app, contact us at the address below.
privacy.retention: We retain your account and discovery data while your account is active. Deleting your account deletes the associated account, routes, and discovery data from our application database.
privacy.feedbackRetention: Feedback helps us improve Hecate and respond if you request a reply. Account deletion removes the account ID link from stored feedback, but does not remove the feedback content or copies sent to our support inbox. Contact us below if you want feedback containing personal information removed.
privacy.children: Hecate is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.
privacy.changes: We may update this policy when our practices change. We will publish the updated version on this page and revise the effective date.
privacy.contact: For privacy questions or deletion help, email supporthecate@gmail.com.

support.allowLocation: Allow location access when Hecate asks for it.
support.startWalk: Tap the Start control to begin a journey.
support.finishWalk: Tap Stop or Finish when you are done. Background location is also available for optional discovery reminders in Account & sync.
support.location: On your iPhone, open Settings → Privacy & Security → Location Services → Hecate and allow location access. If you want a journey to continue while the phone is locked, allow the location access option requested by Hecate.
support.signIn: If you use an email sign-in link, open it on the same device where you requested it. It should return you to Hecate. Check your spam folder if the email does not arrive.
support.deletion: Open the account and sync panel in Hecate, select Delete account, and confirm. This permanently removes your account, routes, and discoveries.
support.contact: Email supporthecate@gmail.com. Please include your iPhone model, iOS version, and a short description of the issue. Do not send passwords or precise location history.
